spans.s: ङीप् fem. affix ई which is anudatta (grave) added (a) to words ending in the vowel ऋ or the consonant न् (cf.
), (b) to words ending with affixes marked with mute उ,ऋ or लृ; cf.
(c) to words end- ing with affixes marked with mute ट् as also ending with the affixes ढ, अण्, अञ्, द्वयसच् दघ्नच्,मात्रच्, तयप्, ठक्, ठञ्, कञ् and क्वरप् (cf.
) and to certain other words under certain conditions; cf.
